why_included: FY2024 revenue +22%; operating margin 42%; ROE 39%; D/E 0.27; FCF $54.1B. Network effects and ad targeting drive pricing.
valuation: Forward P/E 24x; PEG 1.2: fairly valued to modestly undervalued versus growth.
bear_case: Reality Labs losses and AI capex may expand; ad regulation or engagement weakness would hit margins.

why_included: FY2024 net revenue +10%; operating margin about 66%; ROE about 51%; D/E 0.54; FCF $19.8B. Global acceptance network is a durable moat.

bear_case: US interchange litigation/regulation could cut take rates; weaker cross-border travel would slow high-margin volume.

why_included: 2024 operating earnings +27%; insurance underwriting profit $9.0B; D/E 0.21; operating cash flow $46.0B; $334B cash/T-bills. Scale and float are moats.
valuation: Price/book 1.6x and about 23x operating earnings: fairly valued, above its long-run book premium.
bear_case: Catastrophe losses, succession uncertainty and cash drag could reduce returns; Apple concentration remains material.

why_included: 2024 revenue +15%; ROTCE 21%; CET1 15.7%; D/E 1.16 (bank structure); FCF not meaningful—$58.5B net income used. Deposit scale is moat.
valuation: Forward P/E 14x; price/tangible book about 2.4x: fairly valued to modestly rich for a bank.
bear_case: Credit normalization, lower net-interest income or capital-rule tightening can reduce returns and buybacks.

why_included: FY2024 sales +5%; operating margin 3.7%; ROE 31%; D/E 0.31; FCF $6.6B. Membership renewal about 93% in US/Canada supports moat.
valuation: Forward P/E 51x; PEG about 4.2: materially overvalued despite durability.
bear_case: Any renewal or traffic slowdown could trigger severe multiple compression; wage and merchandise costs pressure thin margins.

why_included: 2024 revenue +32%; operating margin about 33%; ROE about 82%; D/E 2.15; FCF about $4.5B. Incretin IP and manufacturing scale support moat.
valuation: Forward P/E 34x; PEG about 1.5: premium but roughly fair versus exceptional growth.
bear_case: Obesity-drug supply/competition, adverse safety data or reimbursement limits could sharply reset growth expectations.

valuation: Forward P/E 32x; PEG about 1.4: fairly valued to rich, dependent on AI growth.
bear_case: AI customer concentration and VMware integration/debt can amplify downside; networking demand may normalize.

why_included: FY2025 revenue +5%; operating income +9%; ROE 24%; D/E 0.73; FCF $12.7B. Grocery scale and logistics support share gains.
valuation: Forward P/E 35x; PEG about 2.8: overvalued versus history and growth.
bear_case: A valuation reset, tariff exposure or food disinflation could outweigh e-commerce and advertising gains.

why_included: 2024 production +16%; upstream unit earnings resilient; ROCE 12.7%; D/E 0.16; FCF $34.4B. Low-cost Guyana/Permian assets underpin moat.
valuation: Forward P/E 13x; EV/EBITDA about 6.5x: fairly valued near integrated-oil history.
bear_case: Oil below roughly $65/bbl, refining weakness or Guyana fiscal intervention would reduce FCF and buybacks.

bear_case: Horizon integration and debt constrain flexibility; biosimilars and obesity-pipeline trial failures could pressure earnings.

why_included: 2024 organic sales +8%; segment margin 23.9%; ROE 21%; D/E 0.54; FCF $3.5B. Electrical installed base benefits from grid/data-center demand.
valuation: Forward P/E 29x; PEG about 2.1: moderately overvalued versus industrial peers.
bear_case: Data-center capex slowdown, project delays or input inflation could expose the elevated multiple.

why_included: 2024 adjusted EPS +10%; regulated ROE about 11%; D/E 1.56; operating cash flow $13.3B less $19.3B capex (negative FCF). Scale in renewables is moat.
valuation: Forward P/E 19x; PEG about 2.2: fair versus utility growth but above sector median.
bear_case: Higher-for-longer rates, refinancing needs, regulatory rulings and project cancellations threaten the capital-intensive model.

why_included: 2024 revenue +10%; gross margin 29.2%; ROE 27%; D/E 0.17; FCF about $1.9B. Land discipline and scale support returns.
valuation: Forward P/E 9x; PEG about 0.9: undervalued if housing demand holds.
bear_case: Mortgage-rate increases, buyer incentives or land impairments can compress orders and margins quickly.

why_included: 2024 net premiums +10%; P&C combined ratio 86.6%; ROE 15.2%; D/E 0.20; operating cash flow $16.1B. Underwriting scale and pricing discipline support moat.
valuation: Forward P/E 13x; price/book 1.9x: fairly valued for superior underwriting.
bear_case: Large catastrophe losses, reserve charges or faster commercial pricing deterioration could reduce book value.

why_included: 2024 revenue roughly flat; operating margin 37.8%; ROE 28%; D/E 1.48; FCF $3.3B. Irreplaceable rail network provides cost moat.
valuation: Forward P/E 19x; PEG about 2.0: fairly valued but not cheap given muted volumes.
bear_case: Industrial recession, labor inflation or service disruptions can reduce operating leverage; regulation may raise costs.

why_included: 2024 gold production 6.8Moz; adjusted EBITDA $7.1B; D/E 0.32; FCF $2.9B. Tier-one reserve portfolio offers gold diversification.
valuation: Forward P/E 14x; EV/EBITDA about 7x: fairly valued, sensitive to gold assumptions.
bear_case: Gold-price reversal, cost inflation, reserve revisions or execution problems at acquired mines could erase leverage benefits.

why_included: 2024 same-store occupancy about 94%; core FFO/share resilient; D/E 1.13; REIT current ratio not meaningful; FCF replaced by core FFO. Scale supports pricing/data moat.
valuation: Forward P/FFO about 18x: fairly valued near premium storage peers.
bear_case: New supply, lower housing mobility and refinancing at higher rates can slow same-store revenue and pressure NAV.

why_included: 2024 revenue +27%; gross margin 40%; D/E 0.07; net cash; FCF about $1.2B. US thin-film technology and contracted backlog support moat.
valuation: Forward P/E 17x; PEG about 0.7: undervalued if bookings and tax credits persist.
bear_case: US policy/tax-credit reversal, project delays, cancellations or cheap imported panels could reduce backlog value.
